notes.title: Demo Patch 10690
notes.content: [h2]The Morbid Metal Demo has been updated to the latest version 10690[/h2][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p]fixed dark/ unreadable UI when HDR was enabled in Windows settings[/p][/*][*][p]added settings to invert camera in X and/or Y-Axis[/p][/*][*][p]fixed player getting stuck outside combat area in one combat scenario[/p][/*][*][p]other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please report any further issues you may encounter. We are determined to deliver a gameplay experience that is as smooth as possible![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
